title: OpenBias: Open-set Bias Detection in Text-to-Image Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the distribution of perceived gender in generated images using a Vision Question Answering (VQA) model, and validating the results against the FairFace classifier, self-identified labels from the Chicago Face Dataset, and the WinoBias occupational dataset.
Assessing the racial/ethnic distribution of people in text-to-image outputs via VQA classification, compared against the FairFace attribute classifier and ground-truth self-identified labels.
Measuring the perceived age distribution in generated images using a VQA model and comparing the agreement with the FairFace closed-set classifier.

Using a Large Language Model (LLM) to dynamically propose arbitrary, context-specific biases (e.g., laptop brand, train color, person attire, wave size) from a set of captions, generating images, and quantifying the bias severity using VQA-based distribution entropy.
